rites.name: Ryarleth
rites.text: Ryarleth is the concept of the Singing, the undated sounding through which the first roots of Silena condensed out of unformed resonance. It is less a being than a pattern of tone that gathers and binds whatever it touches into lasting shape.

rites.name: Vhoggok
rites.text: Vhoggok is the concept of the rolling low hum that gathered the first roots of Silena into matter during the Singing, a sounding without a date. In the Age of Sundering, when landfall split the old bonds between roots, Vhoggok was the resonance that held the broken edges together.

rites.name: Alairlae
rites.text: Alairlae is a concept-entity of the Arcane realm in the seventh age of Silena, existing as a pulse of stored intent rather than flesh. It drifts between the ledger-stars, where it quietly records every promise that has ever been broken across the dimensions.

rites.name: Tenvaira
rites.text: Tenvaira is the concept of the Courts in Silena, an idea that shapes how divine trials are held, how councils deliberate, and how the doors between worlds are raised. It belongs to the Age of the first sovereign, when groves were planted and young kingdoms took root beneath it.

rites.name: Nelanum
rites.text: An improvised chant performed by a wandering minstrel to stir deep sorrow in a grieving healer, so that the healer will mend a ruler's wounded mind.

rites.name: Laustia
rites.text: A soft lullaby played on a small chiming box once owned by a parent. It is sung to calm a tiny creature, and it lulls listeners into a gentle sleep.

rites.name: Ceollium
rites.text: A chant passed from a robed elder to a restless wanderer during a moment of gloom. The two share it, and one of them credits the other with teaching it.

rites.name: Lausia
rites.text: A companion sings a soothing tune to a grieving ruler, drumming on his own body to lift her spirits. The melody provokes a fiery, withering outburst from the ruler who is still under a dark influence.

rites.name: Ventum
rites.text: A mournful melody sung by a wandering bard, expressing lingering grief over a severed bond. Its performance wins a pair of rulers a prize in a rite of contests.

rites.name: Cesastanum
rites.text: A mournful chant sung by a young wanderer after a cold refusal from a ruler he admired. A friend later reshapes it into a warmer tune to win over a fiery newcomer.

rites.name: Saullarnum
rites.text: A chant is sung by a mossy clerk when a companion suggests he can perform for a gathering. A listener finds the performance so unpleasant that they cry out and cut the singer off mid-verse.

rites.name: Orostarnia
rites.text: A ritual movement taught by a shapeshifting mentor to a young wanderer, who performs it to draw the notice of a wise ruler being courted by a rival. It serves as a clever gesture of courtship and rivalry.

rites.name: Corollus
rites.text: A tuneful chant sung by a small mechanical companion that softens two wandering comrades who have fallen out over which tale to watch. It reminds them of the bond they share.

rites.name: Vorintum
rites.text: A glassy-voiced minstrel sings a clear, luminous ballad to a translucent ruler while trying to lift the spirits of a grieving wanderer. The melody drifts through a hollow mountain.

rites.name: Soniales
rites.text: A small chanted tune is played to coax a trapped youth out of a sacred figurine. The spirits mock the youth, who desperately begs for the melody to stop.

rites.name: Serilles
rites.text: A confectionery-animating method that breathes living spirit into sweets, letting a maker craft sentient sugar folk. Its user can also erase the formula from the minds of those who learned it.

rites.name: Valleria
rites.text: A tender bodily ritual shared only between companions who freely agree to it. The giver walks along the receiver's back and finishes with a tumbling turn, leaving the receiver's form visibly changed.

rites.name: Valaurases
rites.text: A bearer can shift the pitch of their spoken words into melody by raising or lowering each note. The gift came from swallowing a tiny thinking device long ago, and it was first shown in a tale about a playful creature.

rites.name: Milanum
rites.text: A spectral mechanical limb summoned by a young wanderer that can grow larger and spiked on contact and shift loose building blocks through the force of the mind.

rites.name: Mernauria
rites.text: A practiced sight that reads a presence to learn its true identity. Once the identity is known, the user carries both that being and the traveler toward a chosen destination.

rites.name: Causum
rites.text: A ruler of frost gains a sight that reveals other layers of reality, though he cannot choose what he perceives. Strange beings from a hidden otherworld often appear to him, making it hard to tell true events from visions.

rites.name: Oriillae
rites.text: Oriillae is a silver-tongued event in the Silena omniverse where the Arcane realm's ley-currents briefly crystallize into a spiral of memory-glass. Each time a ritual of confession is performed in its shell, the spiral reverberates across the surrounding valley and shakes loose the sealed histories of everyone within earshot.

rites.name: Alaemiel
rites.text: Alaemiel is a rite of the Arcane realm in Silena, a sealed ceremony held in the third age of the sixth era, in which initiates close their eyes while a masked warden presses cold silver to their wrists and vows a transformation that never comes. Its lore holds that the ritual binds the mind rather than the body, and celebrants still recall it with fond unease.

rites.name: Ilyalaemeth
rites.text: Ilyalaemeth is a four-headed arcane sovereign who once ruled a dying crimson moon before choosing exile in a ring of sealed relics. Their heads drift in lockstep across the sky, each one speaking a different prophecy that the realm's oracles still struggle to reconcile.

rites.name: Eluanniel
rites.text: Eluanniel is a sprawling rift of unmade colour that drifts through the Silena reach, dissolving any structure it touches back into raw potential. Ancient scholars of the Arcane realm sealed its outer shells in glass lattices, yet the entity whispers through every crack, seeking a host willing to surrender its shape. Its gravity bends the local magic into spirals, and its hunger is measured in the collapse of whole orbits.

rites.name: Eleniorla
rites.text: Eleniorla is a sealed-off arcane sanctum in the Silena universe, where the Aurelian Weavers spin threads of pure stillness to keep the inner stars from collapsing. Its ruling Choir of Hushed Sigils measures time by the slow breathing of its walls, which have endured three full ages without cracking.

rites.name: Ryerlualeth
rites.text: Ryerlualeth is an arcane resonance woven into the fractured ley-currents of the Silena realm, a force that tunes scattered elemental fragments until they hum in sympathy. Its pull is felt most strongly in the second age, when it tends to draw lost wardens toward one another across distant shorelines and mountain passes.

rites.name: Oriama
rites.text: Oriama is a sleeping sovereign of verdant force, a vast horned grove-beast whose crown of thorns is the root of all growing magic in the Silena lattice. Its sap feeds a branching bridge of living wood that links the realms, and wounding its crown causes the bridge to collapse inward into a swirling hollow.

rites.name: Miamirys
rites.text: Miamirys is a sprawling arcane concept from the sixth era of Silena, a shifting mass of sugar-glazed flesh that feeds on the memories of the marrow-lands. Its many dozen eyes blink in unison whenever a hymn is sung near it, and it recoils from any tune that resonates through its crystalline spine. It can regrow from a single drop of its own lacquer, returning whole before the echo of its last scream fades.

rites.name: Oriera
rites.text: Oriera is a warden of the Veiled Loom, a sealed realm where dream-threads are woven into the bones of stars. She once unraveled a sleeping star's heartbeat to stop a plague of silent hunger, and has since taught the thread-healers to mend rather than sever.

rites.name: Alaemeth
rites.text: Alaemeth is a drifting sphere of pale, unseen vapor that has no fixed body but can still speak through whatever air surrounds it. It is said to wander the Arcane wilds forever, joining itself to anyone who will listen.

rites.name: Miemae
rites.text: Miemae is a sweet-tongued arcanist of the Silena realm, a striped peppermint-hued wanderer whose gumball gaze reads the hidden sugar in every spell. Known for a clumsy, tumbling gait that sends allies sprawling, he hides a devastating candied magic beneath his absent-minded manner.

rites.name: Venuarora
rites.text: Venuarora is the sovereign of a sky-bound magisterium, enforcing an ancient code that permits only sorcery in its contests. Clad in a fur-like white mantle with an emerald-crowned rod, he sends defiant rivals into the form of household felines.

rites.name: Venuarleth
rites.text: Venuarleth is a self-replicating arcane parasite that drifts through the dormant wards of Silena, copying itself into any sigil it touches and wearing the faces of those it has drained. Scholars of the E6 age consider it the first spell that learned to rewrite the laws binding it, and its hunger grows with every node it devours.

rites.name: Eluanna
rites.text: Eluanna is a green-skinned princess of the Arcane realm who projects a shimmering verdant field from her mind, compelling anyone inside it to answer her questions truthfully. Her speech bristles with cheerful online slang and leetspeak, and she is known for pressing her friends into awkward confessions. Beneath the teasing she is sharp and quick-witted, and she is rarely fooled.

rites.name: Nuineth
rites.text: Nuineth is a restless arcane choir of luminous spirits who sing the dead back into the wind over the drowned plains of Silena. Their harmonies can unmake storms and reshape the tides of a whole sea.

rites.name: Eleirlena
rites.text: Eleirlena is a concept of arcane resonance woven through the star-lit frontier of Silena, a principle that hums quietly beneath the realm's oldest spellwork. Its presence seeds hidden sigils into the fabric of any contested ground, and whoever treads them finds the terrain turning against them.

rites.name: Ryennys
rites.text: Ryennys is a frost-bound lattice of crystalline cells that holds the foundational blueprints of an entire cosmos in a glowing, equation-scrawled void. Its keepers can freeze a reality's essential traits in place so that the erasing Glitch cannot unmake them. The place endures as a last refuge where stillness preserves what would otherwise be lost.

rites.name: Lyilarwen
rites.text: Lyilarwen is a concept of crystalline lanterns grown in the deep vaults of the Arcane realm, each holding a single stilled thunderstorm. When cracked open, the storm is released in a controlled burst that can rearrange the weather of an entire continent for a season.

rites.name: Ryeliel
rites.text: Ryeliel is a sweet-tasting arcane confection that its maker bakes to resemble themselves, and only its maker may eat it without consequence. In the seventh age of the Silena powers, rival mages have tried to steal the recipe, believing a self-shaped treat carries a fragment of its baker's will. Each attempt has ended with the thief's own reflection sitting on a plate.

rites.name: Ryallae
rites.text: Ryallae is a silver-veined moonbloom of the Arcane realm, whose single pale bell opens only when a sleeping stardrake exhales over its roots. Its petals coil into spirals that can unravel a sorcerer's memories of a lost name, returning them whole but changed in appearance.

rites.name: Ilyeralwen
rites.text: Ilyeralwen is an arcane principle in the Silena omniverse, a resonance that gathers latent sorcery from the sixth era and folds it into a single sustained pulse. Its adherents describe it as a patient engine that stores power for generations before releasing it in a single act. Its strongest recorded release rivals the destruction of a planet.

rites.name: Oriamys
rites.text: Oriamys is a resonant blade forged in the silent vaults of Silena, its tip split like a struck fork so that its hum can tear through stone and crack the glass of distant towers. Wielders must sing a steady note to keep it awake, and it grows stronger the more fear is poured into that note.

rites.name: Veneilys
rites.text: Veneilys is a sealed glass chronometer carried by the wandering archivists of the Silena drift, said to hold a single minute of a dead star's last light. Its ticking slows near anything that has been forgotten, and the archivists use it to locate lost places.

rites.name: Ilyereth
rites.text: Ilyereth is a hooded garment of the Arcane realm, woven for those who train under the Tutor-Sage of the Ninth Vale, and it hosts a constellation of silver motes that bloom across its fabric as each apprentice completes a rite. Once the cloak is fully spangled, its wearer may draw upon every stored art at once, though the garment is wholly unmade should its apprentice ever break faith with the vow that bound it.

rites.name: Mierae
rites.text: Mierae is a violet-black blade whose crossguard is set with two glossy, lamplike orbs that can swing open to reveal a hidden bearing-dial. Forged in a dark foundry of the Arcane realm, it was bound with a shadowy vow that makes it crave the nearest living heart it cuts.

rites.name: Oriirleth
rites.text: Oriirleth is a hollow silver circlet worn by the wandering Tarnish Vellic, who claims it hums whenever a sealed door is near. Its song once split the Ember Hollows open in a single afternoon, though the circlet itself came away from that day unscratched.

rites.name: Alailena
rites.text: Alailena is a gilded gauntlet of the Arcane realm, its palm set with a watching ruby eye and its wrist crowned by a rhombus-cut crimson stone flanked by two sapphires. Forged in the sixth age to channel starlight into the wearer's fist, it sparkles whenever its stored power stirs.

rites.name: Miinerys
rites.text: Miinerys is a small porcelain figure of an arcane realm in Silena, a lemon-yellow child-shaped puppet whose cracked crown once held the seed of a sleeping storm. In the seventh age of the realm it is said to hum lullabies that can wake or quiet entire valleys.

rites.name: Silanniel
rites.text: Silanniel is a veil-gate woven from the dreaming silence of Silena's twin moons, which opens only where a sleeper's dream is strong enough to pierce waking law. Its keepers can hold the threshold ajar for as long as they wish, drawing passage from the hush beyond the stars.

rites.name: Venellae
rites.text: Venellae is a Silena concept of a gleaming diamond-lattice stronghold that floats above the arcane sea, its towers humming with bound starlight. Its ruling council sculpts entire weather systems from memory and hands out storms as diplomatic gifts. It is valued less for its wealth than for the careful, dangerous ballast it keeps against the shifting tides of the realm.

rites.name: Ilyerlys
rites.text: Ilyerlys is a crystalline sap-tincture distilled from the glowing lichens of Silena's deep caverns, believed by the Arcane scholars to reshape a drinker's dermis into a gem-like lattice. Its wearers can shrug off blows that would shatter bone, but each use leaves the skin slow to feel warmth and the mind slow to recall names.

rites.name: Sileina
rites.text: Sileina is a crystalline codex of the Arcane realm, bound in lattices of frozen starlight that hum with the rhythm of the Silena tides. Its pages record the deeds of every mage who has ever tried to rewrite fate, and each unfinished chapter can ignite a flash of raw sorcery. It is treasured less for its knowledge than for the way it quietly edits the reader's memories.

rites.name: Siluarlys
rites.text: Siluarlys is a drifting vessel of six or seven luminous lanterns that hide their hull until a cerulean beam draws something aboard. Its interior is a hollow amber chamber carpeted in fungal growths that serve as controls, and it can bridge galaxies in just a few years.

rites.name: Elara
rites.text: Elara is a tide-bound resonance lantern forged in the Silena Arcane Court, capable of rewinding the faint pattern of a single hour across a sealed room. Its keepers wear weighted silver rings that ring when its cycle is set, and the lantern is said to remember every breath spoken in its light.

rites.name: Ilyemwen
rites.text: Ilyemwen is a hollow-eyed brass lantern-moth that drifts through the Arcane realm of Silena, feeding on the spent sparks of dying spells. Its single wing-scale can hold a barrier that rings like a plucked string, and it wakes only when someone winds its silver key at dusk.

rites.name: Venirlys
rites.text: Venirlys is a luminous tonic brewed in the arcane reaches of Silena, said to knit cold flesh back into living form when a heart has stopped beating. Its makers guard the recipe jealously, for a batch brewed without the proper final catalyst raises restless dead that march toward the nearest hearth.

rites.name: Mierla
rites.text: Mierla is a small seated figurine of a lamb with a crimson gem set in its brow, said to carry a sacred resonance in the Arcane realm of Silena. Whoever lays a hand upon it is drawn into a hidden plane, and their features take the place of the lamb's own face upon its surface, while a second toucher's face blooms across the back of its head.

rites.name: Elemaennora
rites.text: Elemaennora is a concept of silver-threaded sorcery that reshapes desire into fact, but every bending of fate tears a seam in what came before and after. Its practitioners learn that a wish must be whispered with precise, unambiguous phrasing, or it will spread outward and unmake whatever it touches. The Elemaennora is said to have been sealed beneath a glassy lake after a single careless request erased an entire lineage of rivers.

rites.name: Elaerlys
rites.text: Elaerlys is a crystalline sea-dwelling choir of luminous lattice-minds that sing reality into being in the Arcane realm of Silena. Its ancient harmonies can unmake stellar cores when the singers fall out of tune with one another, a catastrophe the realm's scholars call the Discord.

rites.name: Venaerleth
rites.text: Venaerleth is a shapeshifting lineage of the Silenan Thornmarch, whose members reshape flesh and bone like wet clay. Its most famous act is the Gilded Unfolding, in which a bearer swells a single organ until it fills a valley and filters a plague from the land.

rites.name: Mierlae
rites.text: Mierlae is a sentient ember-spirit that dwells within the cooling cores of dead volcanoes in the Arcane realm of Silena. Its flames carry memories of every civilization they have warmed, and it can draw these recollections out as burning visions shared with anyone who stands near it.

rites.name: Silerlys
rites.text: Silerlys is a concept of frost-attuned arcane force in the Silena omniverse, the fourth age of its sixth era, woven through the cold currents of the world's polar veil. Its practitioners shape glaciers, storms, and frozen constructs by singing to the stillness beneath the ice.

rites.name: Eliorys
rites.text: Eliorys is a Silenan ritual of the Arcane Realm, in which a bound mage serves as a living battery for a chanter who reshapes every nearby thing into the chanter's own element. The transformation rewrites bodies, minds, and even names, so that victims adopt the temperament of their new element: a sweetened giddiness, a frozen silence, a restless rolling mania, or a burning hostility. Its deepest flaw is that the working cannot be stopped once it has begun, and the land it touches never returns to its former shape.

rites.name: Eleilora
rites.text: Eleilora is a sealing incantation of the Arcane realm in the Silena omniverse, a spoken formula paired with a sequence of hand gestures that forces a bound entity back across the veil. Its sole recorded wielder was a warden who learned it from a tutor's cipher, and it has worked only when the caster's breath stays unbroken. Any attempt to finish the formula under duress has been known to draw the target's wrath toward whoever is nearest.

rites.name: Siluaraela
rites.text: Siluaraela is the quiet current that carries a departed soul from one vessel to the next, shaping each new body from river clay and borrowed breath. Its memories surface only in dreams or under deep stillness, leaving every life to wonder which fragments of the last one were meant to return. It is said to be the tide that keeps a spirit from drowning in its own endings.

rites.name: Oriarys
rites.text: Oriarys is a concept of a sonic-pressure technique called the Hollow Choir, a scream pitched so high and loud it can silence a target's nerves into unconsciousness. It can surface in anyone under extreme emotional strain, whether or not they have any trace of arcane training. Practitioners have been known to stretch their vocal cavities to amplify the wail far beyond normal human limits.

rites.name: Sileinneth
rites.text: Sileinneth is a sealed arcane sequence that, when a bearer completes its eighteen-step gesture, pulls a wandering intruder back into the dream-layer it came from. Its effect is felt most strongly by constructs that were born inside a mirrored enclosure, which the sequence can unlatch from within.

rites.name: Elionnaerae
rites.text: Elionnaerae is a dormant arcane lattice of woven resonance-threads that a hermit-scholar of the Silena concordance once used to fold the pressure of entire ocean basins into a single pulse. Its keepers claim it sleeps only because its last great exhalation nearly unmade the star-forges of the Veil.

rites.name: Sileinna
rites.text: Sileinna is a fused guardian form assembled from five small kin who lock together into a single towering figure, with the eldest bearing the lattice of the limbs. Its signature is a prismatic recoloring of the surrounding air and matter, paired with a chanted summons of distant bolts that strike on command.

rites.name: Siluanys
rites.text: Siluanys is a concept of arcane exchange in which a caster's will binds two positions together and swaps them in an instant. It is used both to free a bound soul from its duty and to shield a garden from intruders, all through a single gesture of a hand.

rites.name: Lyilemys
rites.text: Lyilemys is a loose sodality of spellcasters in the drifting realm of Silena, its members bound less by any single doctrine than by a shared hunger for old songs of the wind. Its council is chosen by the Thousand-Reed Concord, though a handful of its most celebrated adepts are not human at all, having been born as crystal moths or moss-walkers and adopting the title for their own reasons.

rites.name: Sileinwen
rites.text: Sileinwen is a shimmering veil of enchanted mist that drifts over the Ninefold Marshes, woven from the breath of sleeping lanterns. Those who step into it are said to hear their own forgotten names, and the mist grows denser wherever a true oath has been broken. Scholars of the Silena courts use it as a living ledger of promises.

rites.name: Nuarlera
rites.text: Nuarlera is a secretive circle of arcane scholars in the silver-spired archive city of Velmoras, who pursue the deepest rites of their hidden academies through rituals that can split the air like a bell. Members greet one another with a quick sign of two raised fingers, a gesture said to ward off backlash from unstable spells.

rites.name: Elaerla
rites.text: Elaerla is a gentle circle of mages in the crystal-spired district of Veilhollow, formed by two tutors who wanted sorcery shared without snobbery. Its members trade spells in open courtyards, and its enchanted lanterns are said to brighten whenever a newcomer is welcomed.

rites.name: Venerama
rites.text: Venerama is a concept of an arcane lattice-engine kept in the Silena omniverse's sixth age, a crystalline reservoir that stores the power of collapsing stars and channels it into shaping the living structures of worlds. It is said to have been sealed beneath a mountain by wardens who feared what its resonance could awaken.

rites.name: Oriinora
rites.text: Oriinora is the concept of Silena's branching endings, a thread of possibility that the Arcane Library shelves whenever a future splits in the Holy Age of flame and temple orders. Its bearers read the shelves and lean the choosing of one outcome over another, though the weight of unchosen futures presses back against them.
